placeResult.description: We created Ché Chá thinking of a relaxed and flexible space where you can enjoy with family and friends a new gastronomic proposal that uses high quality natural products, combining them in creative and stimulating recipes. We are a restaurant & Bar concept that brings us together in an urban oasis.
placeResult.reviews_summary: CHÉ CHÁ Tea Bar & Food Station in Miraflores is a popular spot for both locals and visitors. Many travelers praise the fresh ingredients, creative flavors, and beautiful presentation of the dishes, particularly the breakfasts and fusion cuisine. While service is often described as attentive and friendly, some note occasional slow service during busy periods. Guests appreciate the good value for money, convenient location, and inviting atmosphere, making it a favored choice for repeat visits.
